name: frontend-interaction-design-plugin
description: Turns product requirements, frontend prototypes, and backend API contracts into reviewable interaction models and frontend development plans without generating code.

interface.shortDescription: Turn requirements into reviewable frontend design plans.
interface.longDescription: Analyze a product PRD, frontend prototype, and backend API contract in a strict pipeline that produces a user flow, frontend state model, API sequence diagrams, and an implementation-ready frontend development plan. The plugin creates design documents only and never generates or modifies application code.
defaultPrompt: Turn this PRD, prototype, and API contract into a complete frontend interaction design package.
Generate a Mermaid user flow from this product requirement and prototype.
Create the final frontend development plan from these approved interaction artifacts.
